prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Kansas City. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Kansas City Missouri for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but to give the best, accurate list I need one quick detail from you:

- Do you mean Kansas City, Missouri or Kansas (or a ZIP code)?  

Also helpful but optional: your age (child/teen/adult), whether you strongly prefer Invisalign, and whether you have dental insurance. With that I’ll return a short, prioritized list of 6–8 specific orthodontists/clinics to call with brief reasons (credentials, Invisalign experience, tech, location, patient reviews) plus phone numbers and what to ask at the consult.

If you want to start now, here’s a quick, practical plan and a script you can use when calling any orthodontist, plus what to look for so you can choose confidently.

What to look for in a Kansas City orthodontist (quick checklist)
- Board certification: American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) indicates additional testing/credentialing.  
- Proven Invisalign experience: look for “Platinum” or “Diamond” Invisalign provider status (means many cases treated).  
- Technology: iTero or other intraoral scanner, CBCT/3D imaging for complex cases, digital treatment simulation.  
- Transparent pricing/financing: clear total estimate, monthly plans, and whether insurance is accepted.  
- Free or low-cost initial consult.  
- Good recent patient reviews (Google/Yelp).  
- Location and schedule that fit your routine (fewer and shorter visits if convenience matters).  
- Follow-up/retention plan included (retainers, replacement policy).  

Questions to ask on the phone or at consult (short script)
- “Do you treat adults/teens/children, and do you offer Invisalign as well as braces?”  
- “Are you board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics?”  
- “How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year (or what’s your provider status)?”  
- “Do you use a digital scanner for impressions?”  
- “What is the estimated total cost and monthly payment options? Do you accept my insurance (name it)?”  
- “What is the expected treatment time and how often will I need appointments?”  
- “Who will do the adjustments — the orthodontist or a staff member?”  
- “Is a retainer included? What is your emergency policy?”  

Sample 30–60 second phone script
“Hi — I’m calling to schedule a consultation. I’m interested in Invisalign (or braces). Do you offer free/low-cost consults? Also, is the orthodontist board-certified, and do you use digital scans for Invisalign? I have X insurance (or I’m self-pay).”

If you confirm city/ZIP and age, I’ll compile 6–8 named recommendations with why to call each (credentials, Invisalign experience, tech, location, contact info) and rank them for fastest/most aesthetic/most affordable options. Which ZIP or side of Kansas City should I use?
